consumer: The frontend inventory-panel renderer that reads avatar.carried_items[] from the snapshot JSON and SHOWS the top-level list of what the player holds.
scope: only the character's own carried items, top-level (wielded/worn/inventory slices) — not recursing into container contents and not reachable-nearby inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — iterates the avatar's wielded_items, worn, and inv_const_slice top-level stacks and emits each item's display_name/symbol/location into carried_items[] as a formatted display view for the panel
divergence: Player wields a backpack containing a first-aid kit that holds bandages: the panel must show the backpack (and other top-level items) only; a wrong answer that deep-recurses contents (Excerpt-2 visit_internal style) would also list the bandages, diverging from the top-level display the GUI should present.
